Game Overview

Alien City puts players into a action experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Each session of Alien City follows a consistent rhythm. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Alien City?

Alien City is a free action game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Alien City free to play?

Yes, Alien City is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
